text.p: SyQuest Technology Inc said it completed a transaction involving an investment of $30 million in preferred stock, lifting the total of funding raised in the past five months to $50 million.
The Fremont-based maker of removable cartridge hard drives said the transaction was facilitated by New York financial consulting firm Wharton Capital Corp.

"This latest new funding is another important step in our plan to rebuild the company's balance sheet, accelerate product development and improve manufacturing capability," said Edward Marinaro, chairman of the board at SyQuest.

On June 16, the company, which has struggled to regain its footing after a string of quarterly losses, said it received a separate private investment of $20 million in a transaction also facilitated by Wharton.
A spokesman for SyQuest said six firms were backers in the latest investment.
